messages.snippet: James — our mark-up attached (tracked). Main points for Brindley: (1) tighten the borrowing consent
messages.subject: RE: Project Indigo — Subscription Agreement (our mark-up)
messages.plaintextBody:
James — our mark-up attached (tracked). Main points for Brindley: (1) tighten the borrowing consent threshold from £500k down to £250k; (2) lower the information-rights threshold to 1% and shorten management accounts to 15 business days; (3) bring the general warranty time limit down from 24 to 18 months. The rest is light. Let's discuss the borrowing number if it's a problem.

Oliver

messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah — Birchall's first turn. Borrowing threshold at £250k is too tight given the equipment leases the company runs; I'll propose £350k. 1% info rights and 15 BDs are fine. 18-month warranty limit is acceptable. Drafting our counter now.
